Peri-implant marginal bone loss (PIMBL) estimated by linear measurements on digital periapical radiographs (ImageJ, National Institute of Mental Health, Bethesda). Distance from implant-abutment connection to the most coronal bone-to-implant contact, measured mesially and distally parallel to the implant long axis. Three examination points: implant placement (IP), 'baseline' (~6-7 months later at definitive-crown delivery), and 1 year after functional implant loading. Sign convention: all reported deltas are positive values representing bone loss (increasing distance over time); no negative/gain values reported, no explicit sign-convention statement beyond this.
